type CallError struct { Code ErrorCode Description string Details json.RawMessage }
type CallInfo struct { ConnInfo Action string MessageID string Direction Direction }
type Caller interface { Call(ctx context.Context, action string, req, resp any) error }
type CloseError struct { Code int Reason string }
type ConnInfo struct { StationID string Version Version Role Role SessionID string }
type Direction uint8
type Dispatcher interface { Dispatch(ctx context.Context, p Peer, action string, payload json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) }

type ErrorCode string

type Interceptor func(ctx context.Context, info CallInfo, next func(context.Context) error) error

type NopMetrics struct{}

type Role uint8
